sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No phonology content and no wordlist. The article is a 1934 administrative patrol report (route, settlements, dress, houses, karawari initiation houses, crops, anthropometrics). Its single linguistic remark, made in the passage on the Baudji (Bauzi) camp at the Gesa river, is 'De taal verschilt van die der naburige Gesa-bewoners' (the language differs from that of the neighbouring Gesa people), followed by a note that assent is signalled by a short soft whistle. Nothing is said about Nisa/Benefa speech, words, stress, accent or tone.
